title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 5.36
exact_target: For a Hadamard-gap power series whose coefficients are not absolutely summable, ask separately whether it takes every finite value once, infinitely often, and in every angular sector.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2305036 (AMR-022-5036). CC BY 4.0.
